race.comment: NOVAMIRA (7) was in the market behind a short-priced favourite on debut at Bendigo and ran a game second on heavy ground. The winner there had been highly competitive in some top 2yo races and doubt she finds that level of competition here. She can go one better. INDALO (4) is a filly by Cosmic Force on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard who has made a good impression at the jumpouts. Jamie Melham on from a soft draw, expecting a big run. SMOKY KITCHEN (9) is a filly by I Am Invincible for the Maher yard who has won a jumpout nicely. Well-bred sort who should be ready to go. RUBY GUILD (8) has been thereabouts in two runs to date and warrants respect off a let-up. NAFSIKA (5) is a Toronado filly for the McDonald yard. Watch the market for a lead.
